channel.title: Letters · Tyler White
channel.description: Tyler White on proving what design is worth: PRDs and kickoffs, case studies that show impact, and AI workflows for product designers.

item.title: The PRD template I actually use (and how to fill it from one kickoff call)
item.description: A free PRD template to copy and paste, plus how to fill it from one kickoff meeting so engineering gets a doc they'll actually read. Example included.

item.title: Design rationale: how to explain design decisions without defending them
item.description: How to write and present design rationale: which calls aren't up for debate, how to document the ones that are, and a decision record format to reuse.

item.title: UX case study examples that prove what the work was worth
item.description: What strong UX case study examples have in common: a structure built around decisions, results placed where they land, and a slide about what went wrong.

item.title: The UX case study template I'd use (built around decisions, not screens)
item.description: A free UX case study template structured around decisions and outcomes, plus five questions that pressure-test the story before your next portfolio review.

item.title: The product designer portfolio homepage structure that sells before anyone scrolls
item.description: How to structure a product designer portfolio homepage: a one-line hero, a proof strip, case studies sorted by outcome and result-first headlines.

item.title: How to run a project kickoff meeting that actually kicks something off
item.description: A project kickoff meeting agenda that forces real decisions in 60 minutes: the four questions to ask, who should be in the room, and what you leave with.

item.title: Product brief template (and the design brief questions that actually matter)
item.description: A free product brief template plus the design brief questions that matter, so design gets pulled in before the decisions are made, not after.

item.title: Cursor for designers: why I left Figma Make for real product work
item.description: Why I switched from Figma Make to Cursor for real product prototypes: the credit burn, the spec-driven loop that replaced it, and when Figma still wins.

item.title: PRD vs BRD: which one you actually need (probably not both)
item.description: PRD vs BRD explained: what each document covers, who owns it, when to use it, and why most product teams are better off with one doc instead of two.

item.title: UX metrics that actually make it into the exec deck
item.description: The UX metrics and KPIs leadership cares about: adoption, retention, efficiency and revenue, plus how to estimate impact without perfect data.

item.title: The AI prototyping workflow I actually use (and where it breaks)
item.description: A real AI prototyping workflow for product designers: load context, explore 4-5 directions to kill bad ideas fast, test in code, then polish. Prompt included.
